chunks: Sa'd narrated from al-'Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from 'Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Aban, from al-Halabi, who said:
Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام said: “Regarding the witr: Allah has only prescribed the five, and the witr is not prescribed as an obligation. If you wish, you may pray it, but leaving it is unbecoming.”

key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the witr prayer, the odd-numbered night prayer

ai.seo_question: Is the witr prayer obligatory in Islam according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the obligatory daily salat (prayer) are only five, and that witr is not among the obligatory prayers. At the same time, it emphasizes the importance of witr by describing its omission as blameworthy, showing its strong recommended status.
